|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the current text (version 2 of 2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-17-Colonel_Jendon_In_Onyx_1-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026); the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Colonel Jendon In Onyx 1 (Virtual Block 6)]]): Virtual Block 6.3 (Mercenaries) release sheet, released 12 March 2010<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>, official text as of 15 March 2010<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-17-Colonel_Jendon_In_Onyx_1.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-coloneljendoninonyx1-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 53) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. An exact reprint of an earlier text is a stale reprint: it is not a new version and does not make this text current again (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, on the Virtual Block 6 list and the Virtual master list in every archived capture from 21 July 2012 (the earliest with game text) to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1263_17">Players Committee website card list: VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “May deploy as a 'react.' Permanent pilot is •Jendon, who provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Onyx 1. Adds one battle destiny if with Onyx 2. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' a comma is added after “•Jendon” (“Permanent pilot is •Jendon, who provides”). The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes. The list also prints the concept credit as text and writes the title “Colonel Jendon in Onyx 1” with a lower-case “in”.
